dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Offense Erupts for 373 Yards as Rams Outlast Packers 26–13 to Reach 7-4
bullets: Packers Win: Los Angeles moved to 7-4 (2nd in NFC West) with a 26–13 home victory over Green Bay [therams.com Official](https://www.therams.com/news/blake-corum-sets-career-high-32-rushes-for-career-high-184-yards-in-rams-win-over-packers-on-thanksgiving-eve). The offense erupted for 373 total yards (5.3 yards per play).

Corum & Stafford Shine: Blake Corum totaled 205 scrimmage yards and 1 touchdown, highlighted by 184 rushing yards. Matthew Stafford threw for 140 yards, 0 TDs, and 1 interceptions (67.3 rating) [Jourdan Rodrigue](https://bsky.app/profile/jourdanrodrigue.bsky.social/post/3n36zi4ywv22g).
Weaponry & Debuts: Kyren Williams added a 10-yard rushing score [Jourdan Rodrigue](https://bsky.app/profile/jourdanrodrigue.bsky.social/post/3n36zi4ywv22g).

Defense & Trench Tape: The defense bottled up Green Bay's ground game (55 yards, 0 TDs) and forced 3 takeaways (Jaylen McCollough's interception and Emmanuel Forbes Jr.'s interception). Chris Shula's unit closed out the final possessions [Rob Demovsky](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50602564/packers-micah-parsons-accountability-rams-return).

Looking Ahead: Four-man pass rush and secondary health headline early-week focus as Los Angeles turns to Week 13 preparations against the Kansas City Chiefs [therams.com Official](https://www.therams.com/news/from-the-podium-head-coach-sean-mcvay-quarterback-matthew-stafford-running-back-blake-corum-outside-linebacker-myles-garret-rams-win-over-packers-on-thanksgiving-eve-2026-press-conference).
